lines: Breaking News: The Golden Scarab commits horrific act of terror at capitol building!
Early in the morning, numerous improvised explosive devices were detonated around the left wing.
Several politicians and military officials were near the blast site, including Lieutenant General Izolda.
Fortunately, despite the numerous casualties, all major military officers present in the left wing survived with no major injuries.
Our condolences to those affected. God Bless Aijinkova.
